_about: Registry of this style's components (SYSTEM.md): what each one is, its kind and the regexes (sig) that find it in a built index.html. scripts/components.py plan / check / add / record read and write it: history lists your reels in order, projects maps a reel id to its project folder, and each element's reels say where it was used. Empty history = nothing used yet.
_about_components: kind = hook / scene / prop / frame / transition / outro (new every reel) or emphasis / signature / house (may stay); sig = regexes (a LIST) on the built index.html, each tested on a reel's delivered index.html (bespoke generator) and on the tactile.py rebuild (data keys and texture names; the new-every-reel sigs never match the inlined runtime alone); history = reels in order; projects = where each reel's index.html is. scripts/components.py reads and writes this file.

ideas_not_built_yet: before / after in place: zoom out 22 f on twos + a hard-edge left-to-right wipe on ones from the textured page to its flat twin, the one-word label rising (ref T7 + C10, R5)
page turn as an object wipe between two paper scenes: the outgoing scene is the front, the incoming one the back (FINDINGS 10)
reverse turn: the old page comes back from the LEFT, linear 8 f (ref C7c) for a callback
top-down desk collage: papers (screenshots, receipts, letters) unfurl / slide onto a desk plate on their nouns, contact shadows, desk grain on ones (ref C11)
crimson zig-zag scribble cross-out on a 'no' or a wrong page, 80 % on the first drawing, glued to the paper (ref C6)
cut + blur breath on threes: sigma 3 / 8 / 18 / 12 / 6 / 3 with no scale change (ref T16)
an arrow whose head tracks a moving element (FINDINGS 10)
zoomed screen-recording crops on the named control, cursor in frame, value changing, camera following the cursor (ref C12): only with the speaker's own screen recordings (tutorial / AI-tool reels)
paper foley: page flip on every turn's landing frame, paper slide / tap on landings, rustle under unfurls (library/sfx now has paper-flip and paper-riffle from the CC0 pack; no slide / tap yet)
open-end loop cut: end on the speaker's face 0.5 s into a new sentence (ref 'And now...'): only if the user asks, the default ending is flat
page fold v2: the source flap narrows toward the bottom (a wedge) and casts a shadow on the ground; ours is a straight cylinder with a CSS drop shadow (replica REPORT)
Tactile collage: the study proposed merging Tactile paper with a paper collage style and giving the collage stepped motion + paper foley (not decided)
